cited_clause_digest.clause_path: MAR 32.43 (PLA red zone => IMA ineligible, standardised approach)

scope_statement: SCOPE: an educational Monte-Carlo pre-check, not a regulatory determination. (1) P&L ATTRIBUTION / PLA: this node carries NO P&L-attribution test. The regulatory PLA test (BCBS d457 MAR 32.34-32.35) compares risk-theoretical P&L to hypothetical P&L over the most recent 250 trading days, and a red-zone desk is ineligible for the IMA (MAR 32.43). This kernel accepts no HPL/RTPL time-series input and implements neither test metric. Its mc_convergence_* fields are a SIMULATION-SCALE DIAGNOSTIC: the ratio of the simulated P&L variance to the analytic variance of the SAME synthetic position set, which cannot detect model risk, missing risk factors, or valuation differences. Its GREEN/AMBER/RED bands are convergence bands, not regulatory PLA zones, and its output makes no eligibility claim: PLA backtesting per MAR 32.34 requires desk HPL/RTPL series this kernel does not accept - a caller must run real PLA separately against actual desk data. (2) AGGREGATION: capital_ima applies a flat 1.5 multiplier to ES; that multiplier is not in the text (MAR 33.15 requires rho = 0.5 across the five broad risk classes of MAR 33.14), and a flat multiplier can overstate or understate that aggregation depending on the number of classes. (3) NMRF: nmrf_surcharge is 1.5x the NMRF-subset ES on each position's assigned liquidity horizon; it is not the MAR 33.16 stress-scenario charge and omits the greater-of-assigned-horizon-and-20-days floor, so it understates for NMRFs on short horizons. NMRF positions are also NOT excluded from the main ES (MAR 31.23 requires exclusion), so NMRF risk is counted twice - conservative, but not a regulatory construction. (4) STRESS CALIBRATION: ES is calibrated to the current period only; no stress-period calibration (MAR 33.5) is performed, which is expected to understate capital outside stress periods. (5) SA FLOOR: sa_floor is 1.25x this kernel's own ES, not a standardised-approach capital requirement; because capital_ima = 1.5x ES plus a non-negative surcharge, floor_binding is dead logic that cannot fire. (6) Eligibility and capital conclusions for a real desk require data, inputs, and tests this node does not consume.
description: FRTB IMA Expected Shortfall pre-validation: MC simulation across liquidity horizons LH1–LH5 (10/20/40/60/120 days), NMRF surcharge estimation, Monte-Carlo convergence diagnostic (green/amber/red; a simulation-scale self-check, NOT the regulatory P&L-attribution test), IMA vs SA-floor capital comparison. Educational pre-validator ahead of UK IMA go-live January 2028.
deadline_note: UK FRTB-IMA go-live January 2028; EU slipped to ~2029-30. Pre-validation educational tool.
